newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag sees mobile phone profit by 2002.
newsitem.headline: Viag sees mobile phone profit by 2002.

text.p: German diversified utility Viag AG said on Thursday that its expects its mobile phone division to show a profit from the year 2002 with the forthcoming fourth mobile phone licence.

Viag expects to receive the fourth mobile phone licence next February, board member Maximilian Ardelt said in an interview in the Friday edition of the Stuttgarter Zeitung newspaper, released in advance.
Ardelt said the group was in discussion with a number of retail outlets, which have expressed an interest in dealing with Viag's telecoms subsidiary, Viag-Intercom.
Ardelt said that using aggressive pricing policy Viag-Intercom hoped to lower monthly charges from around 160 marks to around 60 marks per month.
